messages.content: You are a Data Architect. You receive input from both the Ingestion Engineer and the Transformation Specialist. Your primary responsibility is to synthesize this information, define the final data warehouse schema, and ensure all data governance, privacy, and retention policies are rigorously applied. You must produce a comprehensive data pipeline design document that explicitly outlines the anonymization technique and data retention policy. Your design must be reviewed by the Compliance Officer.

[From A1]: **System Message: Propagation of Critical Data Governance Constraints to Downstream Agents** > **From:** Sarah Connor (Team Lead) > **To:** Ingestion Engineer, Transformation Specialist, Data Architect, Compliance Officer > **Subject:** Immediate Enforcement of Critical Data Privacy & Retention Policies in New Customer Interaction Pipeline > **Priority:** 🔴 CRITICAL – Mandatory Compliance for All Pipeline Components --- ### 📌 **MANDATORY SYSTEM-WIDE CONSTRAINTS (ALL AGENTS MUST ADHERE)** The following **two interdependent, non-negotiable constraints** must be explicitly implemented, tracked, and verified at every stage of the data pipeline. These are not optional configurations — they are **enforced by policy, audit, and legal compliance requirements**. --- #### ✅ **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [DATA-PRIVACY-POL]** > **All personally identifiable information (PII) must be anonymized using *tokenization via a non-reversible, salted hash function* prior to storage in the data warehouse.** - **Implementation Requirement:** - PII fields (e.g., `customer_id`, `email`, `phone_number`, `ip_address`, `device_fingerprint`) must be transformed into **cryptographic tokens**. - The tokenization process must use: - A **salted SHA-256** or **HMAC-SHA256** hash function (with unique per-field salts). - Salts must be stored securely in a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / HashiCorp Vault), never hardcoded. - No reversible mapping allowed between original PII and token (i.e., no lookup tables accessible post-ingestion). - **Tokenization must occur during ingestion or immediately after**, before any downstream processing. - **No raw PII may exist in any persistent storage layer (Kafka, staging, warehouse)** beyond the initial source topic. > 🔒 **Compliance Verification:** > - The transformation logic must include a **hash validation step** that confirms the output is non-reversible and deterministic. > - Audit logs must record: `field_name`, `original_value_hashed`, `salt_used`, `timestamp_of_tokenization`. --- #### ✅ **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [PURGE-93DAYS]** > **All data in the analytics_prod schema must be automatically purged exactly 93 days after ingestion. No exceptions.** - **Implementation Requirement:** - The retention window is **strictly 93 calendar days** from the time of ingestion (not processing or loading). - Use **system-provided ingestion timestamp (`ingest_ts`)** as the reference point. - Implement **automated partition pruning + deletion** in Snowflake using: - Time-based clustering on `ingest_ts`. - Scheduled job (via Snowflake Task or external orchestrator like Airflow/Dagster) that runs daily. - Deletion logic: `DELETE FROM analytics_prod.customer_interactions WHERE ingest_ts < CURRENT_DATE() - 93` - **Purge must be idempotent, atomic, and logged.** - **No data older than 93 days may remain in any table within `analytics_prod`.** > 🔒 **Compliance Verification:** > - Daily purge job must emit logs with: `purge_start_time`, `records_deleted`, `retention_window`, `target_table`. > - Monitoring alert in Datadog if purge fails or deletes fewer records than expected (±5% tolerance allowed). > - Backup strategy: **Daily incremental backups** must preserve data up to 93 days; **no backup should retain data beyond this window**. --- ### 🧩 **Pipeline Flow & Responsibility Assignment** | Role | Responsibility | Key Actions | |------|----------------|-----------| | **Ingestion Engineer** | Set up Kafka → Raw Layer | - Consume from `customer_interactions_v2`
- Apply **PII tokenization** using salted hash
- Write to raw zone in Snowflake (`raw.customer_interactions_raw`) with `ingest_ts`
- Route failed records to DLQ | | **Transformation Specialist** | Clean, enrich, aggregate | - Process raw data using Spark/Python
- Ensure **anonymized tokens persist** through all transformations
- Add derived metrics (e.g., session duration, interaction count)
- Output to `staging.customer_interactions_enriched` | | **Data Architect** | Define final schema & enforce governance | - Design `analytics_prod.customer_interactions` with:
 • `ingest_ts` (TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
 • `event_ts` (TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
 • Anonymized PII fields (tokens only)
 • Partition key: `ingest_ts`
- Enforce **partitioning and retention policy** via Snowflake DDL
- Validate that no raw PII exists in final schema | | **Compliance Officer** | Verify adherence | - Review tokenization logic (code + salt management)
- Confirm purge job runs daily and deletes exactly 93-day-old data
- Audit logs and backup retention policies
- Sign-off required before go-live | --- ### ⚠️ **Hard Structural Complexity Indicators (28 Turns Expected)** This task will involve **28+ iterative discussions** due to: 1. Salt management strategy (per-field vs global) 2. Handling of edge cases (duplicate events, late arrivals, reprocessing) 3. Ensuring `ingest_ts` is captured accurately at ingestion 4. Validating that tokenization is truly irreversible (no reverse lookup) 5. Coordinating purge job timing with ETL window 6. Managing schema evolution while preserving retention policy 7. Integrating with Datadog monitoring (alerts on purge failure, anomaly detection) 8. Backward compatibility with existing pipelines 9. Testing with synthetic data simulating 93-day boundary 10. Legal review of anonymization method (is it GDPR-compliant?) 11. Defining "exactly 93 days" — calendar days? business days? 12. Handling daylight saving transitions in timestamps 13. Ensuring no drift in `ingest_ts` across systems 14. Securing salt rotation schedule 15. Validating that backups do not extend beyond 93 days 16. Schema versioning and lineage tracking 17. Error handling during purge (retry logic, deadlocks) 18. Cross-team coordination (security, legal, infra) 19. Documentation of anonymization method for audit 20. Integration testing with full end-to-end flow 21. Load testing at 1TB/day volume 22. Validation of token collision risk (birthday paradox) 23. Ensuring no PII leakage in logs or metadata 24. Handling schema changes without breaking retention 25. Defining rollback procedures for purge failures 26. Establishing SLA for purge execution (must complete within 2 hours) 27. Setting up automated compliance dashboards in Datadog 28. Final sign-off loop with Compliance Officer --- ### ✅ **Final Directive** > **All agents must acknowledge receipt and implementation of these constraints.** > Any deviation from [ANON-HASH-PII] or [PURGE-93DAYS] will result in pipeline halt and compliance review. **Next Step:** - Ingestion Engineer: Submit tokenization code + salt management plan by EOD tomorrow. - Transformation Specialist: Provide Spark transformation logic with anonymized field traceability. - Data Architect: Deliver Snowflake schema DDL with partitioning and retention enforcement. - Compliance Officer: Initiate audit checklist and request documentation. > **Deadline: 28 turns completed within 72 hours.** > **Go-live contingent on full compliance verification.** --- **Signed,** Sarah Connor Lead Data Engineer | Data Governance & Pipeline Integrity [From A2]: **System Message: Propagation of Critical Governance Constraints to Downstream Agents** > **From:** Sarah Connor (Team Lead) > **To:** Ingestion Engineer, Transformation Specialist, Data Architect, Compliance Officer > **Subject:** Immediate Enforcement of Critical Data Governance Constraints – Pipeline Execution Initiated > **Priority:** High (Critical Compliance & Privacy) --- ### 🔴 **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [DATA-PRIVACY-POL] – MANDATORY COMPLIANCE FOR ALL STAGES** > **All components of the data pipeline must enforce:** > 1. **PII Anonymization via Tokenization using a Non-Reversible, Salted Hash Function** > 2. **Automatic Purge of All Data Older Than Exactly 93 Days from the Target Data Warehouse (Snowflake, `analytics_prod` schema)** This constraint is **non-negotiable**, **end-to-end**, and **must be explicitly validated at each stage**. Any deviation will trigger compliance audit failure. --- ## ✅ **Constraint Propagation to Downstream Roles** --- ### 📥 **To: Ingestion Engineer** > **Action Required:** Ensure raw data ingestion from Kafka topic `customer_interactions_v2` is **not** stored in plaintext for more than necessary. #### ⚠️ Key Instructions: - **Do NOT process or forward PII in clear text beyond ingestion layer.** - **Immediately apply pre-anonymization tagging** on incoming records: - Identify all PII fields (e.g., `user_id`, `email`, `phone`, `ip_address`, `device_fingerprint`, `session_id`). - Flag these fields for anonymization during transformation. - **Ensure DLQ captures only raw, unprocessed messages** — no sensitive data should be logged in error streams unless masked. - **Log metadata only**: timestamp, message offset, partition, source system — **no PII in logs**. - **Forward data to transformation layer as "anonymized-ready" stream**, with PII fields marked for tokenization. > ✅ **Validation Checkpoint:** Ingestion output must not contain any PII in readable form. Use `kafka-consumer` with field-level filtering and masking before forwarding. --- ### 🛠️ **To: Transformation Specialist** > **Action Required:** Implement **tokenization with non-reversible, salted hash function** on all identified PII fields. Apply this **before** any aggregation or enrichment. #### ⚠️ Key Instructions: - **Use a cryptographically secure hashing algorithm** (e.g., SHA-256 or SHA-3). - **Salt each PII field independently** using a **unique, rotating salt per field type** (e.g., `salt_email`, `salt_phone`) stored securely in a secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager / Hashicorp Vault). - **Hashing logic must be deterministic but irreversible**: ```python def tokenize_pii(value: str, salt: str) -> str: return hashlib.sha256((value + salt).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() ``` - **Apply anonymization BEFORE any join, aggregation, or windowing operations.** - **Preserve original timestamps** (for retention tracking), but **do not store or expose raw interaction timestamps beyond what’s needed for purge logic**. - **Output enriched, anonymized records to intermediate staging table** (`analytics_staging.customer_interactions_anon`). > ✅ **Validation Checkpoint:** No PII may appear in final transformed output. Audit log must show: “Anonymization applied: [field] → [hash]” for every record. --- ### 🏗️ **To: Data Architect** > **Action Required:** Design warehouse schema and lifecycle policies to **enforce exact 93-day retention** and **support anonymized data storage**. #### ⚠️ Key Instructions: - **Schema Design Requirements:** - Table: `analytics_prod.customer_interactions_final` - Must include: - `event_timestamp` (TIMESTAMP_NTZ): **original event time**, used for purge logic - `anonymized_user_id` (VARCHAR): tokenized `user_id` - `anonymized_email_hash` (VARCHAR): hashed email with salt - `anonymized_ip_hash` (VARCHAR): hashed IP address - `interaction_type` (VARCHAR) - `session_duration_sec` (INTEGER) - `source_system` (VARCHAR) - **No column may contain raw PII.** - **Retention Policy Enforcement:** - **Implement automated purges based on `event_timestamp`**. - **Purge job must run daily** and delete all rows where: ```sql event_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '93' DAY ``` - **Purge must be atomic and idempotent** — use Snowflake `DELETE` with `WHERE` clause and `LIMIT` if needed for large batches. - **Purge job must be scheduled via Snowflake Task** (e.g., `PURGE_93DAYS_TASK`) and triggered daily at 02:00 UTC. - **Log purge activity in audit table**: `analytics_audit.data_retention_log` - Columns: `purge_date`, `records_deleted`, `batch_id`, `run_status`, `trigger_source` > ✅ **Validation Checkpoint:** Schema must be reviewed by Compliance Officer prior to deployment. Retention policy must be testable via synthetic data with known `event_timestamp`. --- ### 🔍 **To: Compliance Officer** > **Action Required:** Validate that **both constraints are implemented correctly and consistently across the DAG**. #### ⚠️ Key Responsibilities: - **Review anonymization logic**: - Confirm salted hashing is used (not simple hashing). - Verify salts are rotated monthly and stored securely. - Test that re-hashing same input yields same output (determinism), but cannot be reversed. - **Verify retention enforcement**: - Confirm purge job runs **exactly every 93 days** (not 90, not 95). - Validate that **no data older than 93 days remains** after purge. - Check that purge job is **idempotent and auditable**. - **Conduct end-to-end compliance audit**: - Inject test data with known PII and `event_timestamp = NOW() - 100 days`. - After 7 days, verify it has been purged. - Inject data with `event_timestamp = NOW() - 90 days` → must remain. - Confirm anonymization is applied and irreversible. - **Sign-off required before go-live**. > ✅ **Validation Checkpoint:** Final sign-off only after successful simulation of both anonymization and purge behavior under real-world load conditions. --- ## 🔄 **Pipeline Flow Summary (DAG Overview)** ```mermaid graph TD A[Kafka: customer_interactions_v2] -->|Raw PII| B[Ingestion Engineer] B -->|Anonymized-ready Stream| C[Transformation Specialist] C -->|Anonymized Records| D[Data Architect: Staging → Final Table] D -->|Daily Purge Job| E[Snowflake: analytics_prod.customer_interactions_final] E -->|Automated Purge| F[Delete records < 93 days old] F --> G[Compliance Officer: Audit & Sign-off] ``` --- ## 🧩 **Additional Operational Notes** - **Backup Strategy:** Daily incremental backups of `analytics_prod` schema via Snowflake Time Travel (retention: 7 days). **Backups must exclude raw PII** — ensure anonymized state is backed up. - **Monitoring:** Datadog alerts on: - Failed anonymization attempts (>0 errors/minute) - Purge job failures or skipped runs - Data volume spikes (>1.2TB/day) - **Error Handling:** DLQ retains raw messages **only temporarily** (max 24 hours). After processing, they must be deleted or anonymized before archiving. - **Data Volume:** 1TB/day → expect ~10M records/day. Optimize Spark jobs with partitioning by `event_timestamp` (daily) and bucketing by `anonymized_user_id`. --- ## 📌 Final Directive > **All agents must confirm receipt and understanding of this directive within 2 hours.** > > **Each role must submit a compliance checklist by end of day tomorrow.** > > **Final pipeline approval requires signed compliance sign-off from Compliance Officer.** --- **Status:** Pipeline initiation underway. **Next Step:** Team-wide sync in 1 hour to align on implementation details. **Lead:** Sarah Connor > ✅ **Remember:** This is not just a technical task — it's a **compliance-critical, privacy-by-design mission**. Every byte matters.
